commits.message:
Rename toplevel namespace "edgedb" to "edb".

The motivation behind this rename is to clearly separate server
implementation from client code:

- "edb" is a namespace for edgedb server and related code and tools;
- "edgedb" is a namespace for edgedb Python binding.
commits.author: Yury Selivanov

commits.message:

Issue #192.

commits.message: Put EdgeDB under the Apache License v2.0

commits.message:
Improve friendliness of error messages generated by invalid references

References to non-existent types and pointers will now produce a list of
similar-looking valid alternatives.  Additionally, invalid link and
property reference error has a cleaner message.
commits.author: Elvis Pranskevichus

commits.message:
Convert to explicitly sized numeric types

We currently have int which is a 64-bit integer, and float, which is a
double precision IEEE754 value.  Postgres supports other numeric
precisions, and it makes sense to expose them.

Naming-wise we follow the modern convention of specifying the bit size
of
commits.author: Elvis Pranskevichus
